'''Tanna Odann''' was a [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] serving the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Territory Administration]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Odann issued a press release banning the [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|Corellian Merchants' Guild]] from the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].
